about_the_game:
Anemorie is a visually captivating, story-driven adventure set in the 1990s, where you step into the life of Anna—a young woman navigating the complexities of self-discovery, love, and resilience. Living with a heart condition, Anna possesses a unique gift: the ability to glimpse memories embedded in cherished objects.

🌻 Narrative-Rich Gameplay: Immerse yourself in an emotional journey as Anna confronts her past, explores her supernatural abilities, and forges meaningful relationships.

🌻 Thematic Mini-Games: Engage in unique, context-specific mini-games that reflect Anna's experiences and challenges, offering deeper insight into her world.

🌻 Daily Activities: Assist Anna with her daily routines—from cooking breakfast and journaling to bonding with her beloved cat, Kohi—each activity revealing more about her character and story.

🌻 And so much more

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 / macOS 10.13 (High Sierra)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible or built-in sound card
  • Additional Notes: Minimum resolution of 1280x720 (720p)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated or built-in sound card supporting high-quality audio playback
  • Additional Notes: Recommended resolution of 1920x1080 (1080p) or higher for optimal visuals
